conservative_4k_random.workload: 100% random aligned 4KB host writes with the drive 100% full

source.title: Micron 9550 SSD Series Technical Product Specification

notes: Use conservative_4k_random for the primary result. The sequential rating is an optimistic sensitivity for a measured large, sequential, log-structured KV write path. The 3.84TB SKU sustains 14/6 GB/s sequential read/write; the 10 GB/s headline write rate applies only to larger capacities.
